children: Lion engaged ICP Securities to provide automated market making using its ICP Premium™ algorithm to support share liquidity.
Entered a market making agreement with ICP Securities dated Sept 17 to provide automated market making services.
ICP will use its proprietary ICP Premium™ algorithm in compliance with CSE rules and applicable law.
The Initial Term is four months starting Sept 17, auto-renews monthly unless 30 days' notice is given.
ICP will be paid C$7,500 per month plus taxes; no performance fees, options, or other compensation included.
ICP and Lion are arm's length; ICP may acquire shares in future subject to CSE policies; ICP bears its trading costs.
